op.message:
security(serve): adversarial fixes — bounded PDP exec + wire caps + list/check consult (T-009)

F-1: PDP consult is bounded — try_wait poll against [serve.pdp]
timeout_ms (new field, default 5000) kills a hung child; verdict
reads cap at 64KiB via Read::take so a flooding yes-style child
blocks on its own pipe and dies on the deadline; the request
writes on a helper thread so >64KiB requests can't deadlock.

F-2/F-6: request line capped at 4MiB (bad_request + resync);
field caps — actor 256B, attestation/value 64KiB, ref 1KiB,
id 4KiB serialized.

F-3: list/check consult the PDP (op=list/check, ref omitted) —
list decrypts records, check probes vaults incl. scoped-token
gets; verdict attaches to the scoped Ops so incidental
materializations carry policy. Manifest/docs corrected.

F-4: PDP child env scrubbed to the arca-shell allowlist
(scrub_env now shared pub); arca serve warns on stderr when
[serve.pdp] exec arrives via an implicit ./arca.toml.

F-5: put/rotate validate value before the consult — a doomed
request never spawns a PDP.

L-1 blank lines documented no-reply; L-3 manifest/shutdown
documented as meta-ops; L-5 fd separation documented; L-6 check
audits error on findings (serve + CLI).
